# Hopf Frame Compilation

> Exact and Fault-Tolerant Compilation of Hopf Differential Frames, by Ruge Lin. Proofs and finite checks for prescribed complete Hopf frames under exact one-qubit/CNOT and coherent Clifford+T resource models.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation

## Use this repository for

- Exact full-frame size, CNOT-count, and clean-workspace/depth tradeoffs.
- T-count versus accuracy and clean/dirty workspace, including one-clean synthesis.
- Simultaneous real-frame T-count/T-depth bounds in explicit precision/workspace regimes.
- Literal diagonals, complete one-target multiplexors, and fixed-decoder Hopf QBP robustness.
- Packed two-clean diagonal precision/workspace bounds and constructive reductions of the linear-T endpoint.

## Selected claims

Start with manuscript/PUBLICATION_SCOPE.md for the complete hypotheses and formulas; docs/README.md maps every proof dependency.

- A: Exact real and phase-dressed complex magnitude frames have size Theta(N), CNOT count Theta(N) for n>=2 (zero for n=1), and depth Theta(n+N/(n+m)) for every clean budget m>=0, N=2^n.
- B: T*=Theta(sqrt(NL)+L+NL/q), G=O(NL), for real and complex magnitude frames with sufficient clean allocation a>=C(n+h), q=n+a+b, h=1+ceil(log2(L+n+2)).
- C: One-clean real-frame T=O(N+L ell_*(n)), G=O(NL), at b>=L+n+7; banked and complex extensions have separately stated reservations.
- D: Two-clean real-frame T=O(sqrt(NL)+NL/b+nL), D_T=O(NL/b^2+nL), G=O(NL), at b>=17(L+n+7). The low-precision corollary and explicit matching intervals are in the selected claim ledger.

Here 0<eta<=1/64 and L=max{6,ceil(log2(1/eta))}. Upper bounds hold for all admitted parameters; matching lower bounds are worst-case over the named family. T-depth permits arbitrary Clifford interlayers and is not total depth. Supplied parameters admit certified evaluation; classical preprocessing is separate from quantum gate counts.

The full initialized-isometry contract includes arbitrary logical and dirty/reference inputs, literal phases, and clean leakage. Return promises depend on the construction: exact synthesis returns all work exactly; B returns dirty work exactly; one-clean operator-core return is approximate within the norm. Actual adjoints and inactive conditional-work sectors are essential. No QRAM, reset, postselection, supplied catalyst, or free evaluator is assumed.

## Read by purpose

- [Claim-led argument](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/REVIEW.md): The problem, four claims, their mechanisms, and operational consequence.
- [Selected claim ledger](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/manuscript/PUBLICATION_SCOPE.md): Canonical assumptions, formulas, retained corollaries, and limits.
- [Proof dependencies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/README.md): A-D and their supporting lemmas.
- [Verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/VERIFICATION.md): Evidence by claim, reproduction, and implementation boundaries.
- [Source map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/SOURCE_MAP.md): Imported premises and local contributions; stable detailed catalogue linked there.
- [Current gaps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/OPEN_PROBLEM.md): Constant-clean high-precision count and large-workspace depth; exact targets and constructive reductions.
- [Research results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/README.md): Endpoint reductions, proved restricted cases, scoped representation limits, and preserved evidence.
- [Packed diagonal compiler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/OPERATOR_SOURCE_COMPILER.md): Section 8 gives error 2^(-ell), T=O(N+ell), G=O(N ell), two clean flags, and b=n+1+ceil((ell+4)/2); matching banked bound at twice that base reservation.
- [Bounded-factor bridge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/BOUNDED_DIAGONAL_FACTORIZATION.md): Any fixed number of literal diagonals fits the endpoint width. Exact coverage implies a terminating certified approximate factor search; coverage itself is a hypothesis.
- [Regular tree Cayley reduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/TREE_CAYLEY_REDUCTION.md): Every angle tuple reduces to one fixed-tree Cayley family with bounded cotangent parameters, two diagonals and exact O(N)-T permutations. Boundary feedback gives an O(nN)-T fine core realization; O(N)-T core synthesis remains open.
- [Boundary propagation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/BOUNDARY_PROPAGATION.md): O(N)-T block encoding of (I-B)/2 and exact full-feedback cancellation leaving one prefix encoder. Self-borrowed queries support R calls at q=N+ceil(log2 R)+9 within b=N+n+7 when ceil(log2 R)<=n-3; their full-operator errors sum below 43 eta/256 but T-count remains O(RN).
- [Coarse prefix encoder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/COARSE_PREFIX_ENCODER.md): Joint complete-prefix encoder at error delta=2^(-ceil(N/n)) and O(N) T-count, with a full-operator regular-core contract and small-conjugation suppression.
- [Collective precision refinement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/COLLECTIVE_PRECISION_REFINEMENT.md): Exact two-flag geometric history, quadratic physical purification, and midpoint/opposite-sign cubic replacement for the terminal regular-core frame. For n>=16, s=ceil(N/n), 3s<=L<=N, error<=40*2^(-3s)+2^(-L) with O(N) T and b<=N+n+7. Actual inverses, baseline dirty disturbance, literal phase and full output are accounted for. Fixed order does not improve the endpoint bound or prove iterable closure.
- [Coupled tree resolvent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/COUPLED_TREE_RESOLVENT.md): All-order graded inverse, tail and support bounds with inverse norm below 43/18 and ideal normalization-three scattering. Direct native synthesis retains O(N+nL), with no literal additive endpoint-width certificate for the completion. Rank-one descendant data, static feedback and the rejected prefix baseline delimit the native-cost inference.
- [Structural compilation limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/STRUCTURAL_COMPILATION_LIMITS.md): Arbitrary-order Haar restrictions, full-output gaps of 1/6 for three masks/two flat Clifford mixers and 1/40 for four masks/three flat Clifford mixers, and rigidity of one Clifford-diagonalizable transported gauge. Extra exterior mixers, more factors and nonflat families retain their own scopes; no unrestricted superlinear T lower bound follows.
- [Source reuse limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/SOURCE_REUSE_LIMITS.md): Exact source fusion, single-bracketing XOR removal and arbitrary-dirty Klein dressing; common Spin closure for address-independent coins and unequal-address higher-grade terms. A full five-call inverse-pair source witness has nonscalar dirty polar phase, without claiming reachability by the fixed global encoder. Logical echoes escape the single-bracketing restriction.
- [Native realification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/NATIVE_REALIFICATION.md): Real targets admit exactly real native completions with at most twice the T-count, one extra clean or dirty qubit, and unchanged full-isometry error. The one-clean endpoint compiler leaves the extra clean flag available. A separate exact ring-valued marker-support obstruction does not apply to approximate sparsity or work return.
- [Spin decoding limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/SPIN_DECODING_LIMITS.md): One doubled spin lift cannot meet endpoint error for n>=4 using a target-dependent inverse encoder or unrelated target-dependent Clifford wrappers. Exact spectral ranks include every dirty spectator; n=3 and general noninverse native wrappers are not excluded.
- [Completed state-based QBP supplement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/supplements/state_based_qbp/README.md): Different-decoder results with their own proof, cost, and native-evidence map; not a fine complete-frame compiler or an application speedup claim.

## Status and attribution

The high-precision count endpoint is 2N-1<=T*<=O(N ell_*(n)), for N=2^n, n>=3, eta=2^(-N), a=2 and b=N+n+7. FAULT_TOLERANT_COMPILER Section 10.3 proves the lower bound using root angle pi/16, unrestricted workspace and the literal-phase contract; Section 10.4 gives return rigidity below that threshold. HOPF_INTERFACE Section 4.1 proves the complete-frame Frobenius tangent metric is 2I even at singular state coordinates. Source- and query-specific obstructions remain distinct from unrestricted lower bounds. Internal review and finite tests are not external peer review, formal proof certification, or a general native emitter.

Use the exact consulted commit and CITATION.cff for attribution. The repository is MIT licensed. Collaborations: gogoko699@gmail.com.
